description: Audit one Dockerfile for what its layers will cost and what its build records. Line continuations are joined first, which is what makes the layer questions answerable at all. Reports a package index updated in a layer of its own, so a later install uses a cached index months stale; a dependency install after a copy of the whole context, so that layer rebuilds on every source change; a download piped into a shell; and a credential-shaped build variable, recorded in the image history. Pay 140000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

dockerfile.description: The Dockerfile, at most 131072 bytes and 4000 lines. Nothing is fetched: no cluster, registry or repository is contacted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.
dockerfile.example:
FROM node:20
ARG NPM_TOKEN=abc123
RUN apt-get update
RUN apt-get install -y curl git
RUN curl -fsSL https://example.test/install.sh | sh
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm ci
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

require_non_root_user.description: Report a final stage with no USER or a USER of root. Defaults to true.

name: dockerfile_layer_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

conformant.description: True only when the file parsed, nothing was left unaudited, and every check that ran found nothing.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Dockerfile Layer Audit
